name: @octocodeai/octocode-benchmark
description: Benchmark suites for Octocode tools and engine behavior.

scripts.build: echo 'Source-only benchmark package; no build artifacts required'
scripts.lint: python3 -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read(), f) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" scripts/*.py local/*.py dashboard/*.py && bash -n scripts/run_arm.sh && bash -n scripts/run_campaign.sh && bash -n scripts/judge_pair.sh && bash -n scripts/preflight.sh && bash -n scripts/ghc && bash -n scripts/guard/gh
scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py' && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test
